tours.name: Add a Salary Attachment Type
tours.description: Learn how to add a type of recurring deduction, such as a loan or an advance, that can be attached to an employee salary.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to add a type of recurring deduction, such as a loan or an advance, that can be attached to an employee salary.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: Attachment types are configured in the Payroll app.

description_i18n.en_US: Attachment types are configured in the Payroll app.

steps.title: Configuration menu
steps.description: The Configuration menu holds the lists of master data used across the Payroll app, such as salary structures, rules and attachment types.

description_i18n.en_US: The Configuration menu holds the lists of master data used across the Payroll app, such as salary structures, rules and attachment types.

steps.title: Salary Attachment Types
steps.description: Attachment types are the kinds of recurring deduction taken from salary, for example Loan repayment or Court order. They are chosen on every salary attachment.

description_i18n.en_US: Attachment types are the kinds of recurring deduction taken from salary, for example Loan repayment or Court order. They are chosen on every salary attachment.

steps.title: New
steps.content: Click New to create a record.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to create a record.

steps.description: The New button opens a blank form.

description_i18n.en_US: The New button opens a blank form.

steps.title: Name
steps.content: Type the name, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the name, then press Tab.

steps.description: Name the type after the deduction, for example Staff loan. The name is shown on the attachment and on the payslip.

description_i18n.en_US: Name the type after the deduction, for example Staff loan. The name is shown on the attachment and on the payslip.

steps.title: Code
steps.content: Type the code, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the code, then press Tab.

steps.description: The code identifies the deduction in salary rules. Keep it short, in capital letters, for example LOAN.

description_i18n.en_US: The code identifies the deduction in salary rules. Keep it short, in capital letters, for example LOAN.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the record.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the record.

steps.description: Saving creates the type. It can now be chosen on salary attachments.

description_i18n.en_US: Saving creates the type. It can now be chosen on salary attachments.

steps.title: Saved
steps.content: The record is saved. Click its name in the breadcrumb to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: The record is saved. Click its name in the breadcrumb to finish.

steps.description: The breadcrumb shows where you are. Use it to go back to the list.

description_i18n.en_US: The breadcrumb shows where you are. Use it to go back to the list.
